lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows extending posteriorly from the branchial slits across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a coordinate-like grid where the blobs serve as anchor nodes within the intensity intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank characterized by a distinct vertical intensity gradient, featuring a high-luminance superior edge and a shadowed inferior margin.
